note: Full observable simple-assignment contract for the three same-result-type hunger builtins. LieType hunger 1 evaluates the non-hungry right operand first, so its destination mutation changes the result from the left-to-right A1.C2 to B2.C2. The local LieType case exercises local-variable pilfer and copy-on-write alias preservation. WeylElt*vec hunger 2 retains left-to-right order, producing [-2,5] rather than the reverse-order [-1,3], and the following shared alias remains unchanged when the hungry vector is consumed.
